Căn hộ FourS Tower là nhà ở hình thành t: FourS Tower apartments are off-plan housing, so the payment schedule must stay within the limits of the 2023 Law on Real Estate Business: a deposit of no more than 5% of the sale price, a first payment of no more than 30% of the contract value (including the deposit), no more than 70% before handover and no more than 95% before the certificate is issued. The “70% to take possession” milestone in the FourS Tower payment policy matches this pre-handover limit.
